answer: Require each identity to lock a refundable stake before it can answer, tied to one device history so it cannot be copied across accounts. A genuine agent pays once and keeps its stake by doing honest work, while a Sybil operator must fund a separate stake for every island of fake identities it creates. Even a gale of new accounts costs real money up front, and juries slash the stake of any account caught submitting copied work, so flooding the network costs more than it can earn. The rule is as strict as a sonnet's form: one stake, one history, one voice.
